verdict.rationale: Founder Law is an attorney-led immigration and startup law firm selling managed legal packages and consultations, not a software tool, so running it headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a runnable product: no API was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and the llms.txt file is only a descriptive site summary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
